name: modify_labels
description: Add or remove labels on messages or whole threads. Archive: remove INBOX. Mark read: remove UNREAD. Mark unread: add UNREAD. Star: add STARRED. Labels are names or ids.

message_ids.description: Message ids, as a list or comma-separated.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids, as a list or comma-separated. Use instead of message_ids to act on whole conversations.
